comment: Generated by `npm run analyse:turnaround -- <id> --write`. Describes the DRAWING, posed — never a delivery target. scripts/v2/turnaround-spec.lint.test.js regenerates this and fails on any drift.

notTraceable.reason: 602px against a 672px standing view — every figure is scaled independently to 4ft, so a z read here is off by 10.4%. Silhouette and colour only.

"skin" and "hair" both resolve to this sheet's #faa364 cluster (42.7% of the figure) — the drawing holds them in one tone, so no colour read can separate them; trace their boundary by geometry, or fix whichever anchor is wrong
